field.label: Enable ctrld
field.help: Starts ctrld as the client-facing DNS listener on the interfaces configured below. Unbound and Dnsmasq are left running and are not touched by this toggle.

field.label: Local-zone resolver host
field.help: The resolver that *.in-addr.arpa reverse zones and the internal domain are delegated to (typically Unbound on its loopback address).

field.label: Local-zone resolver port
field.help: Must match the port Unbound (or another local resolver) is actually listening on for these zones. This is checked against Unbound's live configuration when available.

field.label: DNSSEC notice acknowledged
field.help: Internal flag set when the DNSSEC tradeoff notice on this page has been dismissed. Does not affect ctrld's behavior.
